summary: Offerpad Solutions Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that on August 26, 2026 its wholly owned subsidiary OP SPE SUMMIT, LLC, as borrower, amended its Second Amended and Restated Revolving Loan Agreement with lenders WHGG II TRUST and ASCENT DEVELOPER SOLUTIONS LLC. The First Amendment raises uncommitted revolving borrowing capacity from $100 million to $150 million. The facility retains customary representations, warranties and covenants, including a financial covenant restricting OP SPE's ability to incur indebtedness, plus customary events of default permitting termination and acceleration. No price, premium, stake or change of control terms are involved; this is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation. Watch covenant headroom and funding costs.
